fixes.explanation: Idols, baker. Verse 21 says Amon walked in all the ways of his father, and he served and worshiped the idols his father had served. Those were the same idols his father had served. Like father, like son, and that's the sad part.

Yes, baker. Verse 23 says the servants of Amon conspired against him and killed the king in his palace. The plot came from the people closest to him. The text doesn't give a reason, so I won't make one up.
